---
title: "Quality of life: primary-analysis decision"
subtitle: "Apply the prespecified overall-survival RMST rule"
format: html
---

- Only the death-inclusive fallback is implemented; the principal-stratum branch stops here.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)

rmst_path <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results",
  "rmst-summary.parquet"
)
results_dir <- here("analysis", "03-quality-of-life", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: read-rmst-summary
#| include: false

if (!file.exists(rmst_path)) {
  stop("The OS RMST summary must be available before selecting the QoL primary analysis.")
}

rmst <- read_parquet(rmst_path)

stopifnot(
  "The OS RMST summary does not contain the prespecified QoL decision inputs." =
    nrow(rmst) == 1L &&
    all(c("ci_66_low", "ci_66_high", "rope_low", "rope_high") %in% names(rmst))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: apply-decision-rule
#| include: false

equivalent <- is.finite(rmst$ci_66_low) &&
  is.finite(rmst$ci_66_high) &&
  rmst$ci_66_low >= rmst$rope_low &&
  rmst$ci_66_high <= rmst$rope_high

primary <- if (equivalent) "principal_stratum" else "death_inclusive_ordinal"

decision <- list(
  status = "available",
  primary_analysis = primary,
  supporting_analysis = if (equivalent) {
    "adjusted death-inclusive six-month ordinal QoL"
  } else {
    "principal-stratum and death-inclusive longitudinal Markov QoL"
  },
  reason = if (equivalent) {
    "The entire 66% credible interval for the 182-day OS RMST difference lies within -7 to 7 days."
  } else {
    "The 66% credible interval for the 182-day OS RMST difference is not entirely within -7 to 7 days."
  },
  ci_66_low = rmst$ci_66_low,
  ci_66_high = rmst$ci_66_high,
  equivalence_low = rmst$rope_low,
  equivalence_high = rmst$rope_high
)

writeLines(as.yaml(decision), file.path(results_dir, "qol-decision.yml"))
```

```{r}
#| label: stop-if-principal-stratum
#| include: false

if (!identical(primary, "death_inclusive_ordinal")) {
  stop(
    "The OS rule selected the principal-stratum analysis. The currently activated ",
    "primary QoL stages implement the death-inclusive fallback and must not be run."
  )
}
```
